title: Transfer from a halted configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $c$ be one of its work tapes, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $C$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. If $C$ is halted, then one step of the capture machine from the capture configuration associated with $C$ equals the interpreter-entry configuration associated with $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
replaced:
From the first-phase embedding of a halted configuration of the base machine,
one step of the capture wrapper transfers control to the interpreter entry,
changing no tape contents, head positions, or output.
